item.title: OpenCode Optimization Beyond Configuration — Plugin-Based Optimization
item.description: I previously wrote an article OpenCode Configuration Optimization Record, which addressed token consumption and context management issues. However, configuration optimization handles “how the model runs,” while “the quality of code when it’s half-written” is something configuration cannot manage. This article starts from my development process of the opencode-review plugin, discussing how opencode-review helps an agent review and improve its own code within a session, resulting in higher quality code entering the PR.
